description: Two dropdowns, two axes. 'As of' rewinds valid time — what was true in the world. 'Knowledge as of' rewinds system time — what we had recorded at the time. One station's capacity was mis-recorded and later corrected, backdated 12 days, so the two axes disagree.

panels.title: Fleet capacity
panels.description: Total bike capacity across all stations: true at the selected 'As of' point, as recorded at the selected knowledge basis.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(capacity) AS total FROM stations FOR VALID_TIME AS OF (NOW() - INTERVAL '${days_back}' DAY) FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP '${basis}'

panels.title: Stations open
panels.description: Stations in service at the selected 'As of' point. Late openings drop out as you rewind; since-closed stations come back.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM stations FOR VALID_TIME AS OF (NOW() - INTERVAL '${days_back}' DAY) FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP '${basis}'

panels.title: Capacity grown vs 30 days ago
panels.description: Bikes of capacity added between 30 days ago and the selected 'As of' point — station expansions and openings, net of closures. Both ends read at the same knowledge basis, so this is real-world change only.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(capacity) FROM stations FOR VALID_TIME AS OF (NOW() - INTERVAL '${days_back}' DAY) FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP '${basis}') - (SELECT SUM(capacity) FROM stations FOR VALID_TIME AS OF (NOW() - INTERVAL '30' DAY) FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP '${basis}') AS grown

panels.title: Restated since first recorded
panels.description: Bikes of capacity that were true at the selected 'As of' point but were NOT in the books when first recorded. Same instant of the world, two different records of it. Zero for dates before the audit; 15 after it. This is the axis a history table can't give you.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(capacity) FROM stations FOR VALID_TIME AS OF (NOW() - INTERVAL '${days_back}' DAY) FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP '${basis}') - (SELECT SUM(capacity) FROM stations FOR VALID_TIME AS OF (NOW() - INTERVAL '${days_back}' DAY) FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP '${basis_first}') AS restated

panels.title: Capacity per station
panels.description: Flip the knowledge basis and watch one bar move — the corrected station.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS station, capacity FROM stations FOR VALID_TIME AS OF (NOW() - INTERVAL '${days_back}' DAY) FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP '${basis}' ORDER BY capacity DESC

panels.title: Stations
panels.description: Marker size is capacity at the selected 'As of' point and knowledge basis.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name, lat, lon, capacity, neighborhood FROM stations FOR VALID_TIME AS OF (NOW() - INTERVAL '${days_back}' DAY) FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP '${basis}'

panels.title: The correction — one station, three rows, both axes
panels.description: The only station whose record was corrected, every version of it across both axes. Row 1 is the period the audit didn't touch. Rows 2 and 3 cover the same 12 days: the capacity first recorded, superseded, and the capacity we hold now. No knowledge basis is pinned here — this panel deliberately sees everything.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS "station", capacity, substring(CAST(_valid_from AS VARCHAR) FROM 1 FOR 19) AS "true from", COALESCE(substring(CAST(_valid_to AS VARCHAR) FROM 1 FOR 19), 'still true') AS "true to", substring(CAST(_system_from AS VARCHAR) FROM 1 FOR 19) AS "recorded at", COALESCE(substring(CAST(_system_to AS VARCHAR) FROM 1 FOR 19), 'still believed') AS "superseded at" FROM stations FOR ALL SYSTEM_TIME FOR ALL VALID_TIME WHERE name IN (SELECT name FROM stations FOR ALL SYSTEM_TIME FOR ALL VALID_TIME WHERE _system_from > (SELECT MIN(_system_from) FROM stations FOR ALL SYSTEM_TIME FOR ALL VALID_TIME)) ORDER BY _system_from, _valid_from

panels.title: Capacity history (full audit trail)
panels.description: Every station version with a valid-time bound, as recorded at the selected knowledge basis — the bitemporal rows the 'as of' panels resolve against.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name, capacity, _valid_from, _valid_to FROM stations FOR ALL VALID_TIME FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP '${basis}' WHERE _valid_to IS NOT NULL OR _valid_from > NOW() - INTERVAL '30' DAY ORDER BY name, _valid_from

list.name: days_back
list.label: As of (valid time)
list.description: What was true in the world, this many days ago.
list.query: Now : 0, 1 day ago : 1, 3 days ago : 3, 7 days ago : 7, 14 days ago : 14, 21 days ago : 21, 30 days ago : 30

list.name: basis
list.label: Knowledge as of (system time)
list.description: Which recording of the world to read. The options are the transaction times XTDB assigned: the original load, and the correction.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN _system_from = (SELECT MIN(_system_from) FROM stations FOR ALL SYSTEM_TIME FOR ALL VALID_TIME) THEN 'As first recorded' ELSE 'Current knowledge' END AS "__text", CAST(_system_from AS VARCHAR) AS "__value" FROM stations FOR ALL SYSTEM_TIME FOR ALL VALID_TIME ORDER BY 2 DESC

list.name: basis_first
list.label: First recording
list.description: Hidden. The earliest transaction time on stations, so the restatement tile has something to compare the selected basis against. A panel can't derive this inline: XTDB rejects a subquery as an AS OF bound.
list.query: SELECT CAST(MIN(_system_from) AS VARCHAR) AS "__value" FROM stations FOR ALL SYSTEM_TIME FOR ALL VALID_TIME

title: Bikeshare — As Of
